# Signup confirmation by email code
User selected email-code confirmation instead of browser links. Existing password signup/login and Apple native login remain. Signup creates the password account and transitions to a confirmation form holding only its normalized email; clear password fields. POST /verify with type email, email and the supplied code must return a valid server session before Keychain save and game entry. Invalid/expired code stays on the form. Existing unconfirmed accounts can reach this form by attempting password login; resend uses /resend type signup. A 60-second resend cooldown prevents accidental repeat taps; backend limits remain authoritative. Allow changing email/back to login. Foregrounding must not drop pending confirmation. No new auth credentials are persisted outside the existing Keychain session vault.

Owner manually updated Supabase Confirm signup email to display {{ .Token }} without {{ .ConfirmationURL }}; reset-password template remains a separate owner configuration matching the existing code UI. Keep confirm-email enabled. Preserve original templates in the repository before edits if readable. No user-account creation, verification email sending, token use or session revocation on the user's behalf. EN/JA/KO app copy; simple multilingual code-only email. Verify with stubbed auth tests, build and simulator UI; actual inbox/code end-to-end needs the user's participation.
